1. Click the first button to create a PageFrame window.  
2. Confirm that the Page Component file used as the source (src) for the PageFrame window is displayed. (This example uses the page_component.xml file.)  
3. Review the methods added to the Page Component.  
4. Click each button at the bottom.
5. Confirm that you can directly execute the Page Component's methods within the PageFrame window.
